description: Initial governance records and structurally eligible delegation view. No runtime authority granted.
statements: CREATE TABLE governance.record_status(code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO governance.record_status VALUES('DRAFT'),('ACTIVE'),('APPROVED'),('REJECTED'),('REVOKED'),('ARCHIVED')

CREATE TABLE governance.decision (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, question text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(question)<>''), context text, recommendation text, confidence numeric CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), authority text, final_decision text, decision_date timestamptz, review_date timestamptz, financial_impact text, operational_impact text, strategic_impact text, compliance_impact text, dissent text, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.record_status(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), CHECK(review_date IS NULL OR decision_date IS NULL OR review_date>=decision_date))

CREATE TABLE governance.decision_option (business_id uuid NOT NULL, decision_id uuid NOT NULL, option_number integer NOT NULL CHECK(option_number>0), description text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(decision_id,option_number), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,decision_id) REFERENCES governance.decision(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE governance.approval (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), requestor_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, authority_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, recipient_actor_id uuid, action_type text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(action_type)<>''), object_type text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(object_type)<>''), object_id uuid NOT NULL, object_version integer NOT NULL CHECK(object_version>0), scope text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(scope)<>''), authority text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(authority)<>''), exposure_amount numeric(20,4) CHECK(exposure_amount>=0), currency text CHECK(currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), exact_terms_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(exact_terms_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), terms text, conditions text, decision_id uuid, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.record_status(code), approved_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL, revoked_at timestamptz, FOREIGN KEY(business_id,requestor_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,authority_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,recipient_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,decision_id) REFERENCES governance.decision(business_id,id), CHECK(status<>'APPROVED' OR approved_at IS NOT NULL), CHECK(approved_at IS NULL OR expires_at>approved_at), CHECK(exposure_amount IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE governance.delegation (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), from_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, to_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, authority text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(authority)<>''), scope text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(scope)<>''), terms_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(terms_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), conditions text, effective_from timestamptz NOT NULL, expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL, revoked_at timestamptz, approval_id uuid, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.record_status(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,from_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,to_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,approval_id) REFERENCES governance.approval(business_id,id), CHECK(from_actor_id<>to_actor_id), CHECK(expires_at>effective_from), CHECK(status<>'ACTIVE' OR approval_id IS NOT NULL))
CREATE TRIGGER approval_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON governance.approval FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION governance.protect_issued_approval()

CREATE VIEW governance.effective_delegation AS SELECT d.* FROM governance.delegation d JOIN governance.approval a ON a.id=d.approval_id AND a.business_id=d.business_id WHERE d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.effective_from<=statement_timestamp() AND d.expires_at>statement_timestamp() AND a.status='APPROVED' AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND a.approved_at<=statement_timestamp() AND a.expires_at>statement_timestamp() AND a.object_type='delegation' AND a.object_id=d.id AND a.object_version=d.version AND a.action_type='DELEGATE' AND a.authority_actor_id=d.from_actor_id AND a.recipient_actor_id=d.to_actor_id AND a.scope=d.scope AND a.authority=d.authority AND a.exact_terms_hash=d.terms_hash
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.decision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.decision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.decision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.decision FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.approval FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.approval FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.approval FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.approval FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.delegation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.delegation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.delegation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.delegation FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
